# Fictional law-ingestion fixtures

These files are synthetic test data only. They are not Egyptian legislation, are not derived from Labour Law No. 14/2025, and must never be used as legal evidence.

- `fictional_reference.txt`: a tiny manually-saved text fixture with two article headings and two commencement-date examples.
- `fictional_candidate.jsonl`: matching article-row fixture for comparison tests.

The test creates a temporary original capture and computes its hash at runtime. Permission remains unknown, so a valid provenance record must remain ineligible for retrieval.
